purpose: After rejecting D51, rebuild and flash the clean committed D47/a4da47f60d source from /tmp/pogo-apm-d51-clean to test whether the committed tree alone restores the board.

source.head: a4da47f60d 记录D48D49 USB实验拒绝并恢复D47基线

mavlink.note: The clean committed-tree rebuild did not restore APM CDC enumeration.

decision.reason: Although a4da47f60d has no source diff from a1092831c0 except evidence files, a clean rebuild from that committed tree still HardFaults and does not enumerate CDC. The previously verified D50 runtime therefore depended on main-worktree changes that were not captured in the commit.
decision.risk: The repository lacks a fully committed, reproducible runnable baseline. This must be fixed before treating later experiments as clean deltas.
